_about: Source of truth for the 3 current builds' prices. scripts/apply-prices.py reads today's prices from public/data/price-history.csv, re-prices the builds when a part moved more than 5% since the site's prices, and rewrites builds.html, index.html, lib/catalog.mjs and chat.mjs. Edit rules here, not in the pages.

mb_b850.item: MSI PRO B850-S WIFI6E (Wi-Fi built in)
mb_b850.match_note: 2026-10-30 (Oleg OK'd cheaper equivalents): replaces the Asus PRIME B850-PLUS WIFI (out of stock at Newegg and B&H, Amazon $211.25). MSI PRO B850-S WIFI6E $139.99 sold and shipped by Amazon.com (ASIN B0FR6948FR), in stock. ATX, AM5, Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5G LAN, M.2 Gen5. Graphics slot is PCIe 4.0 x16 (about 1% slower than 5.0 for these cards).

ram_16gb.match_note: 2026-11-07: replaces the Kingston FURY Beast RGB 16GB (2x8GB) DDR5-6000 CL36 (KF560C36BBEAK2-16) because it is out of stock at every trusted store (Newegg's own stock gone, marketplace from 355.55; PCPartPicker lowest = MemoryC 588.16, not trusted; Amazon unreachable). TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB 16GB (2x8GB) DDR5-6000 CL38, black, 279.99 sold and shipped by Newegg, in stock (N82E16820985307). Next option: Corsair Vengeance 16GB (2x8GB) DDR5-6000 CL36 CMK16GX5M2E6000Z36 299.99 at Newegg, Amazon and B&H. Ignore the white Delta RGB kit. PCPartPicker lists this kit at the promo-code price (249.99 after a 30.00 code) - use Newegg's sticker price.

ram_32gb.match_note: 2026-10-31: price source switched from Newegg to PCPartPicker - Newegg's own stock of CMK32GX5M2E6000Z36 was out 2 days in a row (Oct 30-31); PCPartPicker lowest in stock = Corsair.com direct 499.99.

gpu_9060xt.match_note: 2026-10-25: back to the Sapphire PULSE (matches the build photo). Oleg OK'd a third-party Amazon seller for this card: ASIN B0F9LN5VZ6, sold by Nutrend Automotive Inc, $599.99. Newegg out of stock. Third-party sellers are allowed for this part only.

gpu_9070xt.match_note: 2026-10-30 (Oleg OK'd cheaper equivalents): replaces the Sapphire PULSE ($1,049.99 at Newegg). Reaper $919.99 sold by Newegg, in stock (Amazon $919.99 too). 304 mm with bracket, 2-slot (Lancool 207 fits 375 mm), 2x PCIe 8-pin. Hellhound OC now $1,287 at Amazon - not used.

gpu_5070ti.match_note: 2026-10-30 (Oleg OK'd cheaper equivalents): replaces the PNY ARGB EPIC-X OC ($1,349.99). Same PNY card without the RGB lighting, $1,249.99 sold by Newegg, in stock. 299.5 mm, 2.4-slot (Fractal North fits 355 mm); 16-pin via the included adapter on the GF1 850W's PCIe 8-pin cables. Ignore the refurbished listing. 2026-11-01: price source switched from Newegg to PCPartPicker - Newegg's own stock of VCG5070T16TFXPB1-O was out 2 days in a row (Oct 31 - Nov 1, list 1,249.99); PCPartPicker lowest in stock = B&H 1,349.99 (Best Buy 1,500.00, Amazon only a used one at 1,425.00).
